analyzed: aṇḍa jāḥ sarva khaga rūpāḥ jāyante sveda jāḥ krimi kīṭa ādayaḥ udbhid jāḥ taru gulma latā ādayaḥ jarāyu jāḥ nara paśu mṛga ādayaḥ jāyante manasijāḥ nārada ādayaḥ sarve ṛṣayaḥ nārāyaṇaḥ sthāvara jaṅgama ātmakaḥ bhavati aṣṭa vasavaḥ nārāyaṇaḥ ekādaśa rudrāḥ nārāyaṇaḥ nārāyaṇāt dvādaśa ādityāḥ

original: sarve devā ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhagandharvayakṣarakṣaḥpiśācāḥ sarve nārāyaṇaḥ | nārāyaṇa evedaṃ sarvam | lakṣmīrmūlaprakṛtiriti vijñāyate | vastvekaṃ parabrahma nārāyaṇaḥ sanātanaḥ ||
analyzed: sarve devāḥ ṛṣayaḥ munayaḥ siddha gandharva yakṣa rakṣaḥ piśācāḥ sarve nārāyaṇaḥ nārāyaṇaḥ eva idam sarvam lakṣmīḥ mūlaprakṛtiḥ iti vijñāyate vastu ekam para brahma nārāyaṇaḥ sanātanaḥ

original: " catvāri vākparimitā padāni | tāni vidurbrāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ | guhā trīṇi nihitā neṅgayanti | turīyaṃ vāco manuṣyā vadanti |" parāpaśyantīmadhyamāvaikharīrūpā sarasvatīti caturvidhā vāco vadanti | vaikharī sarvavidyāsu praśastā ||

original: tasya niśvasitameva ṛgvedo yajurvedaḥ sāmavedo hyatharvāṅgiraśceti | sarvavedavedāntānāṃ nārāyaṇaparabrahmaṇyeva tātparyam | sa hovāca bhagavān ya evaṃ veda | ityupaniṣat ||
analyzed: tasya niśvasitam eva ṛgvedaḥ yajurvedaḥ sāmavedaḥ hi atharva aṅgiraḥ ca iti sarva veda vedāntānām nārāyaṇa para brahmaṇi eva tātparyam sa ha uvāca bhagavān yaḥ evam vedaḥ iti upaniṣad

original: sa hovāca bhagavān brahmā nārāyaṇayantramantrāvaraṇapūjāmācacakṣe | trikoṇaṃ prathamaṃ bhavati | dvitīyaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ bhavati | vṛttamaṣṭadalaṃ tṛtīyam | caturtha dvādaśadalam | pañcamaṃ ṣoḍaśadalam | caturviṃśati[ḥ]ṣaṣṭham | dvātriṃśati[ḥ] saptamam | aṣṭamaṃ bhūpuram | evaṃ yantraṃ samālikhet |
analyzed: sa ha uvāca bhagavān brahmā nārāyaṇa yantra mantra āvaraṇa pūjām ācacakṣe trikoṇam prathamam bhavati dvitīyam ṣaṭkoṇam bhavati vṛttam aṣṭa dalam tṛtīyam caturtha dvādaśa dalam pañcamam ṣoḍaśa dalam caturviṃśatiḥ ṣaṣṭham dvātriṃśatiḥ saptamam aṣṭamam bhūpuram evam yantram samālikhet

original: madhye lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ vikṣepaśaktyāvaraṇaṃ śaktiprabhāśaktitrikoṇadevatāḥ ṣaṭakoṇaṃ vṛddholkādayaḥ pūjyāḥ | sarvajñānitvatṛptyanādibodhasvatantranityamaluptānantaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaśaktayaḥ | sanakasanandanasanatsujātasanatkumārasanātananāradatumburusamantādayo'ṣṭadalāḥ |
analyzed: madhye lakṣmīnārāyaṇam vikṣepa śakti āvaraṇam śakti prabhā śakti trikoṇa devatāḥ ṣaṭakoṇam vṛddha ulkā ādayaḥ pūjyāḥ sarvajñāni tva tṛpti anādi bodha svatantra nityam alupta anantam ṣaṭkoṇa śaktayaḥ sanaka sanandana sanatsujāta sanatkumāra sanātana nārada tumburu samanta ādayaḥ aṣṭadalāḥ

vasiṣṭha vālakhilya viśvāmitra kaśyapa atri bharadvāja aṅgīrasa jāmadagni gautama agastya jāḥ bāli kapilāḥ dvādaśa dalāḥ matsya kūrma varāha nārasiṃha vāmana rāma rāmakṛṣṇa buddha kalki sadyojāta vāmadevāḥ aghora tatpuruṣa īśāna parameśvarāḥ ṣoḍaśa dalāḥ

śaṃkha cakra gadā padma khaḍga śrīvatsa kaustubha vanamālā ādi kirīṭa kuṇḍala keyūra hāra aṅgada śārṅgi śara nandaka padma veṇu barhi piñcha śeṣa ananta garuḍa viṣvaksena brahmāṇaḥ caturviṃśati dalāḥ keśava ādi caturviṃśati anukramam hari śrī kṛṣṇa mukunda kumuda akṣa puṇḍarīkākṣa dhāmaka śaṅkha varṇa sarvanetra sumukha supratīkāḥ dvātriṃśat dalāḥ
